measurement.scope: The fixed 20-question benchmark remains scoped to the original five pages. Additional pages receive readiness checks without assumed citation results.
engines: Google AI Overviews or AI Mode
instructions: Record a pre-release baseline with the same 20 questions. Do not insert assumed citation counts.
For each observation record UTC timestamp, engine, visible model/mode, country/language, exact question, whether an AI answer appeared, cited TFH URL and whether its product claims were correct.
Distinguish a cited URL from an unlinked brand mention, and an absent AI answer from a citation failure. Repeat observations; personalized and changing answers are not stable rankings.
After an approved release, compare observations and AI-platform referral journeys over an initial 4–6 week pilot. This is an observation window, not a promised time to results.
Use Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance for supported citation surfaces and Search Console's available AI/search reporting. No authenticated account data has been inspected in this pilot.

Existing analytics events add ai_source and ai_source_signal only when a recognized referrer host or utm_source supplies a signal. Ordinary Google/Bing traffic stays unclassified; missing referrers remain unknown.
Compare journey views with existing affiliate_click, official_site_click and newsletter events. Outbound clicks are intent signals, not confirmed purchases. Consent rules remain in place.
Use npm run audit:geo -- --url https://tradersfundhub.com --out .preview/geo-production-crawl.json for a bounded public HTML check. This does not prove indexing or bot-IP access.
